New Chemistry Unit, JNCASR, Jakkur, Bengaluru

content_sections.heading: About JNCASR Research Associate
content_sections.text: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and an Institution Deemed to be University, located at Jakkur, Bengaluru. The Research Associate will work in the New Chemistry Unit on a DST-sanctioned project on thermoelectric materials, with Prof. Kanishka Biswas as the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Ph.D. in Material Science/Chemistry/Physics. Those who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis may also apply. Candidate should have at least two research papers in Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. Expertise in the synthesis of metal halide/Chalcogenide-based materials for thermoelectric applications. Expertise in temperature-dependent electrical transport, thermal transport property studies. Expertise in synchrotron X-ray diffraction, Pair distribution function, and microscopy. Expertise in single crystal growth. Extensive research experience in the field of low temperature physics and materials science. The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 35 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will receive a remuneration of Rs. 58,000/- plus 30% HRA. The notice adds that the remuneration will be fixed based on experience. The position is temporary and is sanctioned in the DST project; the notice does not state the length of the tenure.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Research Associate
content_sections.text: Applications are sent only by email to Prof. Kanishka Biswas, New Chemistry Unit, at [email protected] , latest by 8 December 2026. The application Template is available on the website, as the notice states. Documents named in the notice: Scan copy of the duly filled in Template. Scan copies of original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc. Brief resume.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: JNCASR will shortlist candidates from the email applications. The list of shortlisted candidates will be posted on the website with the interview date. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview/technical discussion/personal interaction.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate vacancies has JNCASR announced?
faq.answer: JNCASR has announced 1 temporary Research Associate position under Advt. No. NCU/EMR/184.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed latest by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Material Science/Chemistry/Physics is required, with at least two research papers in Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who have only submitted their Ph.D. thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that those who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis may also apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the JNCASR Research Associate?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 58,000/- plus 30% HRA, and it will be fixed based on experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the Research Associate remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the remuneration as Rs. 58,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Email the scan copy of the duly filled in Template, scan copies of original testimonials and a brief resume to [email protected], addressed to Prof. Kanishka Biswas, New Chemistry Unit, by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates, whose list will be posted on the website with the interview date, will be invited for an online interview/technical discussion/personal interaction.

faq.question: Q10. Is the JNCASR Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary position sanctioned in the DST project "Phonon-Glass Electron-Crystal Like Ultra-high Performing Thermoelectrics".
